title: RAID START LABEL BACKING
why: The critic still found map text over busy linework and insufficient hierarchy in the contracts panel.
now: Raid-start map labels have dark backing. Contract names and holding states are clearer.

edits.replacement:
ctx.font=nameFont; ctx.fillStyle=row.done?UIC.ok:(mapFirstOn()?UIC.tx_1:UIC.tx_2); ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.fillText(mapFit(row.name,maxW),c.x+q,mid);
      if(mapFirstOn()&&row.rule==='holding'){ ctx.fillStyle=UIC.ok; ctx.fillRect(c.x+Math.round(8*z),ry+Math.round(12*z),Math.max(1,Math.round(3*z)),pitch-Math.round(24*z)); }   // v28.xx (cw-cx-mapstart-plates): a status mark, with no invented selection or new control.

ctx.font=mapFirstOn()?FSz('700 24.6px '+HUDF,z):nameFont; ctx.fillStyle=UIC.tx_1; ctx.fillText('contracts',c.x+q,c.y+th/2);   // v28.xx (cw-cx-mapstart-plates): the panel heading uses the 32px title role.

edits.anchor: if(nm){ ctx.font=FSz('500 15.4px '+HUDF,z); ctx.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; ctx.fillText('SECTOR MAP',hx,_tby); hx+=hudRawW('SECTOR MAP')+Math.round(24*u); }  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
edits.replacement: if(nm){ ctx.font=mapFirstOn()?('600 '+(16*z)+'px '+HUDF):FSz('500 15.4px '+HUDF,z); ctx.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; ctx.fillText('SECTOR MAP',hx,_tby); hx+=hudRawW('SECTOR MAP')+Math.round(24*u); }  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
